items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: I played with Fat Pichon a while at the Absinthe House.

ctx.x: Toulouse Street. The Gaslight, Tony Bessinas. The Dreamland for Sam, Sam and Selma. I played at the Village Bar. I played at the Spotlight. I played at the, I played with Fat Pichon a while at the Absinthe House. Oh, I played a lot of places. Oh, I think I would. Did you ever play any brass band work on the street much? One time. Really? I played a funeral over the river. And I. Whose band was it? That was, I think it was Howard.
Howard had the brass band. Oh, Kidd, I thought it might have been the old man Allen's band.
